A JS-derived bundle is the only mapped asset, so I'll take one read-only client-side look at the origin to witness what the bundle is served into (HTML shell, headers, user UI) before typing presentation/identification.

## ORIENT — what surface the slice actually has

The streamed slice is empty, so I enumerated the unit's mapped surface rather than assume an asset name. The project (`js-current-comfyui-af39fe95`) holds exactly four L0 nodes and nothing else:

- **Domain** `comfyui-manager` (source `historical_replay`), one **BaseURL** `http://comfyui-manager:8288`, and one **Endpoint** `GET /assets/index--PH2IHOc.js` (source `js_structure`, no `content_type`, no `status_code`, no `server`, no `content_length`).
- No `Header`, no `Technology`, no `Certificate`, no `Secret`, no `Observation` nodes at all. No `L1Service` and no `L1System` exists yet — so nothing has been assigned this surface.

What a path *serves* outweighs its name: `/assets/index--PH2IHOc.js` is a hashed build chunk, not an API route. The substantive evidence for this wave is therefore the bound JS publication (`jsctx_84add79b…`, `current-native-af39fe95`, status published, coverage **partial**, 18 gaps), which carries two reconstructed behaviours over three read receipts.

I also attempted one read-only client-side look at the origin to witness the HTML shell, response headers and any user UI (the discipline the `browser` tool owns here, since a plain fetch tool is not bound in this turn). It failed twice with `pool_exhausted` — a tooling gap, and *not* evidence that any header, perimeter or page is absent.

## HYPOTHESISE — candidates per asset+insight

1. `GET /assets/index…js` + behaviour `behavior_cda85e07…` (identity origin) → **IdentificationSystem** (a principal carrier; held also as candidate *AuthenticationMechanism*).
2. Same behaviour (`fetchApi` wrapper: `api_base + /api + path`, caller headers copied, `Comfy-User` injected, JSON/multipart bodies, 200-only accept) + behaviour `behavior_9c0864d3…` (`POST /upload/image` multipart, `/prompt`, `/extensions`) → **RESTApi** (held also as candidate *APIGateway*).
3. The hashed Vite-style bundle itself, plus the client-side stores/toasts `fetchApi` feeds → **WebPresentation**.
4. Perimeter candidates (**ReverseProxy** / **CDN** / **WAF**) from "a named internal host on port 8288" → held and, on the evidence, rejected.
5. **AuthorizationSystem** / **IntegrationSystem** / **Sitemap** → held and rejected.

## CLUSTER PAGES (WebPresentation)

Not possible, and I will not fake it: not one endpoint carries `content_type` or `title`, there is no `text/html` census, and no HTML shell document is mapped. There is exactly one mapped asset and it is a JS bundle, so the only cluster the evidence supports is "the single client-rendered SPA entry bundle" — one presentation mechanism, no per-service clusters to separate. Page-cluster enumeration stays a gap for a wave that maps the HTML surface.

## VERIFY / FALSIFY

- **IdentificationSystem — survives, strongly.** The source reads name the mechanism directly rather than fingerprinting it: `fetchApi` copies caller headers, injects `Comfy-User = this.user`, and fetches `api_base + /api + path` with `cache: no-cache`; `api.user` is set from a client-chosen `userId` persisted in `localStorage` keys `Comfy.userId` / `Comfy.userName`, written by `login({userId, username})` and deleted by `logout`; it is populated *only* when the server config exposes `users`, otherwise the header goes out empty. That is a principal-identification mechanism with the carrier named literally. I fold in the observational edge: identity is **client-asserted** — no server-issued token, nonce or signature appears anywhere in the read — and it rides every API call (`/prompt` status poll, `/extensions`, the audio `POST /upload/image`).
- **AuthenticationMechanism — withheld.** Neither behaviour evidences a credential exchange (no password field, no challenge header, no token issuance); `getUserConfig`/`createUser` are explicitly recorded as unread gaps, and the server-side *validation* of `Comfy-User` is marked `unverified`. "The client sends a user id" is not a proven authentication boundary.
- **RESTApi — survives, modestly scoped.** The support is the access layer, not a URL guess: one `fetchApi` wrapper prefixing `/api`, multipart `FormData` (fields `image`, `subfolder=audio`, `type=temp`) for uploads, JSON responses parsed for a `name` field, status-code-driven error handling (200-only accepted, else toast + thrown `Error`). I type it as a path-prefixed JSON-over-HTTP resource API and do **not** claim hypermedia REST semantics. **APIGateway — withheld**: nothing witnesses an independent gateway/proxy tier; the wrapper is client-side.
- **WebPresentation — survives, narrowly.** A single hashed bundle under `/assets/index-<hash>.js` with client-side stores and router-style data loading is a client-rendered SPA presentation, but the served HTML shell is unmapped, so I assert the mechanism only, not pages or rendering attributes beyond "client-rendered".
- **ReverseProxy / CDN / WAF — withheld.** No `Server:` banner, no `Via`/`CF-RAY`-class header, no certificate, no rule-block observation. The `host:port` naming and the unavailable browser probe justify nothing.
- **AuthorizationSystem — withheld.** The only gate the source shows is client-side (`watchEffect` assigns `api.user` only when the server config exposes `users`); a client-side guard is not proof of server-side enforcement, and no 401/403/302 refusal shape was ever witnessed.

**New vs extend:** there are no currently-defined Systems, so nothing can be extended — all surviving mechanisms are new.

## EMIT — prose delta overview

Three **new** Systems, each adversarially characterised, each grounded on the one mapped `Endpoint` and its owning `BaseURL` (the only L0 witnesses that exist):

- **IdentificationSystem** — *client-asserted principal identification*: the `Comfy-User` request header is copied onto every `fetchApi` call and its value is chosen entirely by the client (`login({userId, username})` into `localStorage` `Comfy.userId`/`Comfy.userName`, deleted on `logout`, populated only when the server config exposes `users`), with no server-issued token or signature anywhere in the read; any caller can name any principal, and every `/api` route — prompt polling, extensions, uploads — inherits that identity, so impersonation is a header edit and per-principal data (queue/history/uploads) is only as isolated as unverified server-side validation makes it.
- **RESTApi** — *single-wrapper JSON API under `/api`*: all client traffic funnels through one `fetchApi` (`api_base + '/api' + path`, caller headers copied, `cache: no-cache`, multipart and JSON bodies, 200-only success, error surfaced as toast + thrown status), so the wrapper is the chokepoint for header injection and the `/upload/image` multipart path (`image` file, `subfolder`, `type=temp`) plus temp-upload `audio/<name> [temp]` references are the file-handling seam to attack.
- **WebPresentation** — *hashed single-bundle SPA shell* served from `http://comfyui-manager:8288`, all views and stores client-side over the `/api` layer; with no HTML census and no content type recorded on any endpoint, the pages/rendering model stay unmapped, so the presentation surface must be re-clustered once the document surface is captured.

**Zero `system_edges` can be emitted in this wave**: the project contains no `L1Service` at all, so there is no `service_slug` to link (the exact reason, not a withheld link). I also carry forward honestly, with no claim of absence: JS coverage `partial` with 18 gaps (`fetchApi`/user-config URL construction partially unread, server-side upload validation and `Comfy-User` authorization unverified, invoking UI caller uninspected, evidence `receipt_only`/`retention_status: missing`), and the browser probe unavailable (`pool_exhausted`) — so no perimeter, header or page mechanism was falsified by tooling.

No Service exists in this project — both the PRIMARY and SECONDARY lists are empty, and my own `graph_view` census confirmed zero `L1Service` nodes. A `system_edges` entry requires a `service_slug` copied verbatim from a real Service, and there is none to copy; minting one here would fabricate a business function, which is not my layer to write. The three Systems I typed therefore stay edgeless in this wave, and every other list stays empty.
